guides.qr: The first row names the columns. Each row after it is a code: its text (a link, or any text) in the first column, then a frame caption and a file name if you like. A frameFontFamily column sets the caption's font. A file with firstName and lastName columns is a file of contacts: each row becomes a contact card, with any of org, position, phoneWork, phonePrivate, phoneMobile, email, website, street, zipcode, city, state, country, version (2.1, 3.0 or 4.0; 3.0 if left out), frameText and fileName. A file without a name in it is named after its caption, else its text. Commas, semicolons or tabs; UTF-8 or Windows-1252. The files are made with the Make tab's design, and a frame shows each row's caption.
guides.barcode: A code a row: its text in the first column and a file name in the second, if you like. A first row naming the columns is optional: data, code, barcode, value, text or url for the code, and fileName, file name, file or name for the file. A file without a name is named after its text. Commas, semicolons or tabs; UTF-8 or Windows-1252.
